This '''hidden fortress''' was the base of operations of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] [[Bo-Dum]] and [[Rarsk (Hutt)|Rarsk]]. It was located on a [[Unidentified planet (Jenna)|planet]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] away from a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Corellian settlement|settlement]].
